correctness.rationale: For three independent chord endpoint-pairs on a fixed nondegenerate triangle, exact edge-pair alternation yields the conditional crossing polynomial \(g\). Direct integration gives \(\mathbb E[g]=2e_2^2\) and \(\mathbb E[g^2]=(20/9)e_2^3-(4/3)e_3^2\). Shared-chord conditioning yields \(\operatorname{Var}(C_3)=3q(1-q)+6\operatorname{Var}(g)\), and Viète uniquely recovers positive normalized side roots. Exact rational and independent quadrature checks plus simulations support, but are not substitutes for, the complete analytic derivation. Both the same-edge exclusion and the strict nondegeneracy hypotheses are used.

value.rationale: A geometric object is recovered from a purely combinatorial crossing statistic rather than lengths or angles: the mean and variance of the three-chord proper crossing count determine every triangle similarity class, and an exact pair proves two chords inadequate even with full law. This is a complete and minimal natural inverse for random segment intersection graphs, not merely an isolated crossing probability.
